title: Telemetry Retrofit — Micro Standup (2026-12-08)
content:
Micro standup notes for the telemetry retrofit workstream — fast sync focused on unblockers and short-term deliverables.

Attendees: Evan (owner), Lina (frontend), Samir (backend/ingest), Jae (analytics), Marisol (sre/infra) — ad-hoc: Noor popped in for 5m.

Goal for this week (short): wire up consistent event schema across UI panel features, land first-pass dashboard for rollout telemetry, and unblock ingestion backlog. Target: soft canary by 2026-12-15 for 10% of panel traffic.

Updates (quick):
- Frontend (Lina): landed schema v0.9 events for panel-open/panel-close/panel-error. PR 1287 is opened; waiting on backend contract tests. Working on adding session_id header to every request — will add fallback if missing. WIP: small perf hit noticed on dev because of extra serialization; trying streaming payload to reduce copies.
- Backend ingest (Samir): deployed ingest lambda with schema validation disabled (to avoid dropping existing noisy events). Currently queuing bad events to bad-events SQS for investigation. Plan: enable strict validation 12/14 after cleaning backlog. Pulled RED-432 (Linear) to prioritize mapping rules.
- Analytics (Jae): built skeleton dashboard in Looker: "panel_telemetry_retrofit_alpha" — shows event rate, error count, avg latency, schema mismatch rate. Needs dimensions for customer_tier and route. Will add time-to-first-byte metric for panel fetches.
- SRE/Infra (Marisol): increased retention for telemetry ingestion logs to 30d temporarily. Observability alert for "telemetry-ingest-error-rate > 5%" created and routed to #ops-panel. Also flagged potential quota spike if we enable debug-level telemetry for all users; recommended enabling debug only for canary.

Blockers / Risks:
- Contract mismatch: frontend v0.9 uses nested meta field that backend currently flattens. This causes ~7% of events to mark as schema_mismatch. Action: Samir/Lina pair debug tomorrow.
- Cost risk: debug-level telemetry could increase egress by ~40% for large customers — need confirmation from Product before enabling globally.
- Canary readiness: we don’t have feature-flag gating for rollout by org size yet. Could be manual for first canary.

Decisions made in sync:
- Keep schema validation OFF for 72 hours after enabling fleet canary. We'll backfill mismatches into bad-events queue and pre-process to upgrade mapping rules.
- Canary scope: start with 10% panel traffic across non-enterprise accounts, region US-West only. Expand if error < 1% and latency impact < 5% for 48h.

Immediate action items (owners + due):
- Lina: add session_id fallback and reduce serialization copies (PR update) — due 2026-12-09.
- Samir: deploy mapping ETL to reprocess bad-events queue and produce upgrade report — due 2026-12-11.
- Jae: add "customer_tier" filter + TTFB metric to dashboard and share snapshot — due 2026-12-10.
- Marisol: add a temporary quota/cost cap for debug telemetry (alert + auto-disable) — due 2026-12-12.
- Evan: coordinate product approval for canary debug policy and confirm enterprise exclusion list — due 2026-12-09.

QA / Test notes:
- Added unit tests for new schema in console repo but need an integration test that simulates nested meta payloads. Lina+Samir to create a small harness that runs end-to-end on staging.
- Manual test checklist created in Confluence: confluence://pages/TELEMETRY-TEST-CHECKLIST (linked above).

Metrics snapshot (quick, local dev staging window 12/07 14:00–15:00):
- total events received: 12,452
- schema_mismatch: 874 (7.0%)
- avg ingest latency: 210ms
- panel error events: 43
- debug payload size (avg): 3.2KB

Open questions / items to triage:
- Should we keep session_id as opaque string or try to derive user-agent/platform semantics? (Product decision; flagged to Evan)
- If we find customers with high debug payloads, do we auto-throttle per-org or per-route? Need cost policy from finance.
- How to surface schema_mismatch samples securely for SRE without exposing PII? Propose hashed sample + redaction layer.

Notes to self (short):
- Keep canary small and monitor the alert "telemetry-ingest-error-rate" strictly.
- Follow up with Data Privacy on PII redaction by EOD 12/09.
- Add a short runbook for rollback (toggle off canary, purge bad-events queue, disable debug) — Lina to draft.

Meeting tags/refs: RED-432, PR#1287, looker:panel_telemetry_retrofit_alpha, confluence:TELEMETRY-RETROFIT, slack:#ops-panel

Next micro-sync: 2026-12-09 09:15 PT (15 min). If anything critical pops up, ping #ops-panel and escalate to oncall.

---
Informal notes below (explicitly scribbly):
- Quick wins: session_id fallback + a small client-side debounce on panel-open could shave ~6% of events (worth it).
- Remember: product might push for enterprise inclusion; we must have a strict opt-out list before that.
- Samir: if mapping ETL is slower than expected, we may need to spin a small Fargate job to speed reprocessing.

End of micro-standup.
